en.title: Number of Two-Person Teams with Skill Sum in a Closed Range
en.description:
Choose two different employees; different indices mean different people, even when their skills are equal. Count the unordered employee pairs whose skill sum lies in the closed range [minSkill,maxSkill].

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n minSkill maxSkill; the second line contains the skills. The original constraints were truncated; this site uses 1≤n≤200000, skills and both bounds in −10^9..10^9, and minSkill≤maxSkill.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 4, 3 and 2. In the second example three employees with the same skill form three pairs.
hints: Sort, and use two pointers to count the pairs with sum ≤K. The answer is count(maxSkill)−count(minSkill−1).
